digest.component_or_area: mutation testing framework and concurrency decision logic
propositions: Mutation testing currently covers only five behavioral cores (signing, gates, next-batch, validate, reducer processors) and lacks coverage for concurrency decision machinery (sync branch selection, compaction fold/rollback, push policy/retry, lock stale-owner/reclamation).
Pure decision helpers must be extracted from subprocess-heavy orchestration modules in sync, push, lock, and compact to enable tractable mutation testing without no-test attribution noise.

New mutation shards targeting pure helpers should be added to docs/mutation-testing.md configuration only after their prerequisite behavioral test stories (S1, S3, S4) land and tests are confirmed passing.

Mutation shards for sync branch selection and lock stale-owner/reclamation are descoped unless this story also adds their behavioral tests; otherwise a follow-up story is required before shards are meaningful.

Mutation shard kill-scores must be recorded in docs/mutation-testing.md and all shards must achieve 100% kill rate to confirm new assertions actually detect mutants rather than just raising line coverage.
